offering_description.value: Ziff Davis publishes online content about technology, shopping, gaming, health and wellness for consumers and healthcare professionals. It sells advertising and lead generation to marketers, refers shoppers to retailers and offers digital games and health apps. It also sells cybersecurity and email marketing software to businesses and consumers.

primary_products.value: digital publications; video games; health and wellness apps; VPN and endpoint security software; email marketing and delivery software

primary_services.value: digital advertising; affiliate commerce and cashback; lead generation; continuing medical education

customer_segment.value: B2B: Advertisers, agencies, retailers, technology vendors, life sciences companies, healthcare organizations and business software buyers; B2C: Readers, online shoppers, gamers, individual healthcare professionals, health app users and VPN subscribers

end_markets.value: technology and consumer electronics; retail and e-commerce; video games and entertainment; healthcare and wellness; business cybersecurity and marketing

revenue_model.value: advertising: Display ads, sponsored content and lead-generation campaigns; commissions or management fees: Merchant commissions on purchases referred through shopping content and offers; subscription: Premium media memberships, game bundles, health apps, cybersecurity tools and email marketing software; product sales: Individual digital game purchases; service fees: Continuing education programs for healthcare professionals
revenue_model.category: advertising; commissions or management fees; subscription; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: other: Digital publisher that turns reporting, reviews and expert contributions into content for readers and ad inventory for marketers; software / platform: Develops health apps, security tools and email software for consumers and businesses; service provider: Uses clinical expertise to develop education for healthcare professionals; retailer: Sources digital games from publishers and sells them to players through its online storefront
value_chain_position.category: other; software / platform; service provider; retailer

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Technology and shopping media, gaming media and commerce, health media and education, cybersecurity and email marketing

distribution_channels.value: online: Company websites, newsletters, mobile apps, online game storefront and software subscription sites; direct sales: Sales teams serving advertisers, agencies and business software customers; partners / resellers: Mobile app stores, digital game marketplaces and cybersecurity channel partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Digital advertising, affiliate disclosures, personal data and commercial email under FTC rules, GDPR, state privacy laws and CAN-SPAM

notes: I’m uncertain about the exact current ranking of the smaller business lines.
